dogecoin.text: @cb_doge Dogecoin (DOGE) is a cryptocurrency inspired by the "doge" meme, featuring a Shiba Inu dog, and has gained significant attention partly due to Musk's endorsements, impacting its market value and public perception.

@cb_doge Kekius Maximus refers to Elon Musk, as indicated by the reply from @soumar_ibrahima, linking Musk to the humorous title "Kekius Maximus" in the context of leading DOGE, which is a playful reference to Dogecoin, a cryptocurrency Musk has publicly supported.
